name: decision_count
description: Counts DECISION and NO TRADE log lines emitted by run-daily. Each successful pipeline execution (past market-hours check, lock, model load, intraday) emits exactly one such line. Zero for a full trading day means the function stopped reaching the decision stage.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="run-daily" AND (jsonPayload.message=~"^DECISION" OR jsonPayload.message=~"^NO TRADE")
